landing.title: Link every task to a client, never miss a delivery
landing.subtitle: Each task belongs to a client and a project. Works offline and syncs across your devices on its own.
landing.featuresTitle: Why this is not a generic to-do list
landing.featureLinkBody: A task knows who it is for. Archiving a client never breaks the link to past work.
landing.featureDeliveryBody: Read the list by delivery instead of priority; see at a glance what has piled up for which client.
landing.featureOfflineBody: Fully usable without a connection. Signing in is optional; your changes are sent once you are back online.
